{{Quote|There's an ancient temple there still. It was serviced for centuries by the Dark Prophets. It's so steeped in the dark side that it formed its own nexus-one so powerful it interferes with all weaponry and technology except for lightsabers.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dark Force Temple''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] temple established on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], one of the many colony worlds of the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and the [[Capital/Legends|Capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Resurgent Sith Empire]]. The structure was so steeped in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that it became a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]].

==History==
===The height of Sith power===
[[File:Dromund_Kaas_temple.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Dark Force Temple at night.]]
Built on a lone bit of solid ground in one of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas's]] many marshes, the Temple was built long after the downfall of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. While its early history has been lost, it was rediscovered by the Sith during the [[Light and Darkness War]] when the Sith and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fought in the marsh surrounding the structure.

[[File:Sith Jedi.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The nexus powered the temple's defenses]]
After [[Darth Millennial]], an apostate [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who rejected [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], found the site, the Temple would come to be inhabited again. Founding the [[Dark Force]] religion on Dromund Kaas, Millennial and his disciples claimed the Temple as their headquarters, operating out of it for centuries. The clergymen of this Order, known as the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] were approached by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] sometime after the fall of the Republic and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and eventually were integrated into the Empire as the Secret Order of the Empire.<ref name="DF5" />

===The Dark Times===
During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Prophets such as Lord [[Cronal]] created horrific [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] such as [[Gorc]], [[Picaroon C. Boodle|Pic]], and mutated [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]]. The Temple served as an elementary training ground for many of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] dark side servants including [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Nial Declann]], and was the childhood home of Cronal's oft-abused daughter, [[Sariss]]. Following the rift between the [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Kadann]] and Darth Sidious, the Prophets abandoned Dromund Kaas and fled into hiding on [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]].<ref name="DF5" /> 

===New Republic Era===
[[File:Mission to Dromund Kaas.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jade and Katarn battle their darksides in the temple.]]
The Temple remained a place of the dark side through the Empire's fall, however, and it was within its walls that Jedi [[Kyle Katarn]] fell to the dark side. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|fought]] her way past Sithspawned Nobhri, [[Vornskr]]s, [[Sith undead]], and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber-wielding]] [[Sith Jedi Statue]]s to redeem her friend, barely escaping the world alive.<ref name="MOTS" />

The Temple would once again be [[Duel on Dromund Kaas|visited]] by Jedi in [[44 ABY]], this time by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] who were in search of the hiding place of members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Ascension" />

==Structure==
Built on the rare layer of solid ground surrounded by [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]],<ref name="DF5" />  the Dark Force Temple consisted of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] buildings protected by a large wall. Inside its gates guarded by [[Color/Legends|gold]] [[Unidentified Sith statues|Sith statues]], a grass-covered courtyard provided entrance to multiple spaces.<ref name="MOTS" /> Tall spires reached up and in those towers leadership of the [[Dark Force]] plotted and studied their [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]].<ref name="DF5" />
The temple featured numerous pathways and long corridors that connected large spaces filled with dark energy. Deep wells and chasms fell into the planet, and walkways could be accessed to cross them if one knew the precise switch pattern. Sinister faces adorned the walls and doors, while some cathedral-like spaces included large  carvings of lightsaber using figures in a duel. Deep below, [[Sith undead]] lie waiting for a command in catacombs. To restrict areas of the temple, Sith statues guarded entrances and rooms.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Force Temple first appeared in [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="MOTS" /> Its description in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'' perfectly matches the depiction of the entrance in the video game.<ref name="Ascension" />
